SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE
    (m.formula = 'Co3Ti' OR m.reduced_formula = 'Co3Ti')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.is_stable, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  c.element AS a_site,
  AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_enthalpy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY avg_formation_enthalpy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND c.element = 'Ni'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.1
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.element)
       c.element AS a_site,
       m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
ORDER BY c.element, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    c.site_label = 'B-site'

LIMIT 10000;

WITH l12_elements AS (
    SELECT
        regexp_split_to_table(m.chemical_system, '-') AS element,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
      AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
)
SELECT
    element,
    COUNT(*) AS stable_l12_compound_count,
    AVG(formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_enthalpy_per_atom
FROM l12_elements
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY stable_l12_compound_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    cp_enthalpy.value AS formation_enthalpy,
    cp_enthalpy.unit AS formation_enthalpy_unit,
    cp_bulk.value AS bulk_modulus,
    cp_bulk.unit AS bulk_modulus_unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bulk ON cp_bulk.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_enthalpy ON cp_enthalpy.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp_bulk.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp_bulk.value >= 150
  AND cp_enthalpy.property_name = 'formation_enthalpy'
ORDER BY cp_enthalpy.value ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, tp.debye_temperature_k
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN thermal_property tp ON tp.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY tp.debye_temperature_k DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN magnetic_property mp ON mp.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND (mp.magnetic_ordering = 'FM' OR mp.magnetic_ordering ILIKE '%ferro%')
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ABS(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  m.chemical_system AS element,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE FALSE) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS negative_formation_enthalpy_percentage
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
GROUP BY m.chemical_system
ORDER BY m.chemical_system
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_eform
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM material_entry m_p
      JOIN composition c_p ON c_p.entry_id = m_p.entry_id
      JOIN structure s_p ON s_p.entry_id = m_p.entry_id
      WHERE m_p.number_of_elements = 1
        AND c_p.element = c.element
        AND s_p.volume_per_atom >= 15
  )
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY c.element
LIMIT 10000;
